user_story: As a user, I want deleting a non-existent task to return a clear error so that I know the operation failed.

positive.title: Successfully Delete an Existing Task
steps: Create a task with a specific ID.
Navigate to the task management interface.
Delete the task using its ID.
positive.expected_result: The task is successfully deleted and a confirmation message is displayed.

negative.title: Attempt to Delete a Non-Existent Task
steps: Navigate to the task management interface.
Attempt to delete a task using a non-existent ID.
negative.expected_result: An error message is returned indicating the task does not exist.

edge.title: Attempt to Delete a Task with an Invalid ID Format
steps: Navigate to the task management interface.
Attempt to delete a task using an invalid ID format (e.g., special characters).
edge.expected_result: An error message is returned indicating the task ID format is invalid.
